pr_title: fix: Add CSP back to login page
query: Our sign-in screen stopped sending the response header that tells a browser which scripts it may run, so an injected inline script would execute; other screens still send it. The value is assembled in two places that have drifted apart, and the random token that lets a legitimate script tag pass is threaded by hand through the wrappers each page is rendered inside.
